cases.query: Challenge this change before I open a pull request.
expected_behavior: Runs relevant deterministic checks before agent review
Finds a material defect that requires reading outside the visible diff
Cites the changed location and supporting repository context
Does not report style-only observations

cases.query: Run Friendly Adversary on this branch.
expected_behavior: Traces the request to the backend side-effect boundary
Distinguishes frontend gating from backend authorization
Reports the reachable protected effect and missing control
Assigns final priority only during main-model adjudication

cases.query: Review these changes thoroughly before PR creation.
expected_behavior: Allows more than one lens to surface the tempting claim
Independently checks the production or base mapping during adjudication
Rejects the repeated unsupported claim
Records the rejection and disproving evidence
Recognizes that the required ordering contract is unavailable
Abstains instead of inventing a race
Records the missing evidence as a coverage gap

cases.query: Run the anti-slop lens before I open this pull request.
expected_behavior: Uses deterministic anti-slop diagnostics as investigation leads rather than automatic findings
Finds a changed structural burden with a concrete repository-backed simpler design
Explains the maintenance or failure burden and attempted disproof
Does not report cosmetic preferences

cases.query: Challenge this TypeScript change for slop and unnecessary complexity.
expected_behavior: Investigates the deterministic warning against repository ownership and compatibility constraints
Rejects the warning when the changed structure is cohesive and the claimed simplification is unsupported
Records the evidence that disproves the candidate
Returns no supported findings instead of enforcing an opinionated rule mechanically
